arxiv-2011-14226.title: On vanishing near corners of conductive transmission eigenfunctions
arxiv-2011-14226.creator: Youjun Deng, Chaohua Duan, Hongyu Liu
arxiv-2011-14226.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Youjun Deng, Chaohua Duan, Hongyu Liu. In this paper, we consider the transmission eigenvalue problem associated with a general conductive transmission condition and study the geometric structures of the transmission eigenfunctions. We prove that under a mild regularity condition in terms of the Herglotz approximations of one of the pair of the transmission eigenfunctions, the eigenfunctions must be vanishing around a corner on the boundary.

arxiv-2105-07897.title: Current-Conserving Relativistic Linear Response for Collisional Plasmas
arxiv-2105-07897.creator: Martin Formanek, Christopher Grayson, Johann Rafelski, Berndt Müller
arxiv-2105-07897.description: Abstract We investigate the response of a relativistic plasma to electromagnetic fields in the framework of the Boltzmann equation incorporating a collision term in the relaxation rate approximation selected in a form assuring current conservation. We obtain an explicit solution for the linearized perturbation of the Fermi-Dirac equilibrium distribution in terms of the average relaxation rate κ \kappa .

arxiv-2209-10366.title: Superradiance induced multistability in one-dimensional driven Rydberg lattice gases
arxiv-2209-10366.creator: Yunhui He ⋆,1, Zhengyang Bai ⋆,2,4, Yuechun Jiao 1,4, Jianming Zhao 1,4, Weibin Li 3
arxiv-2209-10366.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yunhui He ⋆,1, Zhengyang Bai ⋆,2,4, Yuechun Jiao 1,4, Jianming Zhao 1,4, Weibin Li 3. We study steady state phases of a one-dimensional array of Rydberg atoms coupled by a microwave (MW) field where the higher energy Rydberg state decays to the lower energy one via single-body and collective (superradiant) decay. Using mean-field approaches, we examine the interplay among the MW coupling, intra-state van der Waals (vdW) interaction, and single-body and collective dissipation between Rydberg states.

arxiv-2303-14479.title: Explainable Image Quality Assessment for Medical Imaging
arxiv-2303-14479.creator: Caner Ozer, Arda Guler, Aysel Turkvatan Cansever, Ilkay Oksuz
arxiv-2303-14479.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Caner Ozer, Arda Guler, Aysel Turkvatan Cansever, Ilkay Oksuz. Medical image quality assessment is an important aspect of image acquisition, as poor-quality images may lead to misdiagnosis. Manual labelling of image quality is a tedious task for population studies and can lead to misleading results. While much research has been done on automated analysis of image quality to address this issue, relatively little work has been done to explain the methodologies.

arxiv-2410-19170.title: Role of Quantum Coherence in Chirped Dynamic Nuclear Polarization
arxiv-2410-19170.creator: Mayur Jhamnani, Sajith V Sadasivan, Sheetal Kumar Jain, Asif Equbal
arxiv-2410-19170.description: Abstract Dynamic Nuclear Polarization (DNP) is transforming NMR and MRI by significantly enhancing sensitivity through the transfer of polarization from electron spins to nuclear spins via microwave irradiation. However, the use of monochromatic continuous-wave (CW) irradiation limits the efficiency of DNP for systems with heterogeneous broad EPR lines.

arxiv-2412-03434.title: BIMCaP: BIM-based AI-supported LiDAR-Camera Pose Refinement
arxiv-2412-03434.creator: M.A. Vega-Torres, A. Ribic, B. García de Soto & A. Borrmann
arxiv-2412-03434.description: Abstract Abstract. This paper introduces BIMCaP, a novel method to integrate mobile 3D sparse LiDAR data and camera measurements with pre-existing building information models (BIMs), enhancing fast and accurate indoor mapping with affordable sensors. BIMCaP refines sensor poses by leveraging a 3D BIM and employing a bundle adjustment technique to align real-world measurements with the model.

arxiv-2508-12502.creator: Marta Esteves

pmc-11344867.description: IntroductionReduced thrombin generation is an important component of post cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) coagulopathy. To replenish coagulation factors and enhance thrombin generation in bleeding surgical patients, frozen plasma (FP) and four-factor prothrombin complex concentrate (4F-PCC) are used. However, the efficacy–safety balance of 4F-PCC relative to FP in cardiac surgery is unconfirmed.

pmc-12438228.creator: K. Imen, R. Nakhli, M. Bouhoula, L. S. Chaibi, O. Ajmi, N. Belhadj, A. Aloui, M. Kahloul

pmc-13424989.description: ObjectivesArtificial intelligence (AI) offers potential to automatically evaluate the burden of active arthritis on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) but must be reliable and practical to see routine use.
